svg.title: Nucleus-centred KRONOS cell inputs and frozen feature output
svg.desc: A schematic follows the same cell i, nucleus and image field across three panels. The field is centred on the nucleus centroid, with physical width 256 times the selected X sampling and height 256 times the selected Y sampling. The complete cell must fit within this field. Each sample centre selects the level-zero pixel at floor x, floor y and supplies the cell-ROI membership check. The displayed coarse grid represents the production 256-by-256 array. Sampled values outside the target cell, including the neighbouring cell, become raw zero before normalization. Off-image positions are zero-padded. The saved divisor, mean and standard deviation apply to each channel, so raw zero becomes minus mean divided by standard deviation. The fixed KRONOS2 encoder selects its normalized CLS token and returns 768 values associated with the same cell ID. All geometry, intensities and feature glyphs are illustrative; no model result is asserted.
